subject: SolsticeAI SIG / CAIQ call — scheduling and conditional evidence requests
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex@solstice.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ review — Can we schedule a call and get a short artifact list?

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the SIG/CAIQ review as part of our vendor onboarding. We have the completed SIG questionnaire but would like a short live session to walk through any clarifying items and align on what evidence Redwood needs for our security team.

Would you have 30–45 minutes available next week? We're primarily looking to cover:
- SIG items flagged for follow-up (controls around key management, multi-tenant isolation)
- Which artifacts you need up front (SOC 2 report, architectural diagram, config screenshots)
- Timeline for evidence review / redlines

I attached the current SIG workbook (SolsticeAI_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx). Please let us know preferred slots — mornings PT work best for our security folks.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Security Program Lead
Solstice AI

Attachments: SolsticeAI_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex@solstice.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ review — Can we schedule a call and get a short artifact list?

Hi Alex — appreciate the workbook. Happy to run a focused session.

Proposed options (30–45m):
- Wed 2026-11-18 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu 2026-11-19 10:30–11:15 PT
- Fri 2026-11-20 08:30–09:15 PT

Before the call, it would help if you can confirm:
1) Which compliance artifacts you already have (SOC 2 Type II, penetration test report)
2) A point-of-contact for evidence uploads (security@solstice.ai or a named owner)
3) Any specific controls you want us to prioritize during the walkthrough (e.g., data residency, KMS, audit logging retention)

Mina will join to take notes and capture the evidence list. We typically ask for a short architectural diagram (PDF) and example console screenshots for any admin controls so we can map SIG answers to artifacts quickly.

If any of those time slots work, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Customer Security Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex@solstice.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ review — Can we schedule a call and get a short artifact list?

Alex / Vivek — looping Sergio (our infra security lead) for any KMS/ops clarifications. For planning purposes, here's a minimal pre-call artifact list that speeds the review:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or SOC bridge letter
- One-line architecture diagram (network boundaries, VPCs, peering, where keys live)
- KMS provider and key usage doc (HSM/KMS details, key rotation cadence)
- Sample audit logs (redacted) showing admin actions + retention policy
- List of third-party processors + subprocessors

If you can upload these to the Drive link in the next 48–72 hours we'll start pre-mapping answers to SIG. If any items are not available, flag those in the workbook and we'll prioritize them on the call.

We also often accept temporary, time-limited read-only access to a console snapshot (screencast or cloud console role) if that is easier than exporting screenshots.

Thanks,
Mina
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Romero <alex@solstice.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ review — Can we schedule a call and get a short artifact list?

Vivek / Mina — thanks for the quick replies. Wed 2026-11-18 09:00 PT works for our team (I'll invite security@solstice.ai and procurement).

We can provide SOC 2 Type II (Q2 2026) and a one-page architecture PDF. I'll attach the architecture and upload logs to the Google Drive link you shared. A couple of clarifications before the call:
- For the KMS question, we use AWS KMS with a mix of customer-managed CMKs and AWS-managed keys. Is a key rotation policy document sufficient or do you need KMS audit events?
- For retention: our default app logs are 90 days; access logs and audit trails are 365 days. Is that acceptable or do you need different retention windows mapped to SIG control IDs?

Attaching: redwood-architectural-diagram.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Alex
Security Program Lead
Solstice AI

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex@solstice.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, procurement@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ review — Can we schedule a call and get a short artifact list?

Thanks Alex — invite received for Wed 09:00 PT. Agenda for the 30-minute slot:
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Walk through SIG rows with open questions (15m)
3) Artifact mapping and next steps (10m)

Pre-call asks (action items):
- Alex / Solstice: upload SOC 2 Type II PDF, architecture PDF (you attached), and a single example of KMS audit events OR the rotation policy doc (we can accept either; audit events are helpful but not required). Please flag any SIG items you think are RFP vs. artifact-backed answers.
- Solstice security POC: please add a named evidence owner in the shared Drive (so we can track uploads).
- Redwood: we'll prepare a short evidence matrix (control -> expected artifact) and share the Drive folder where you can drop items.

On the call we'll also confirm whether CAIQ mapping is needed in parallel — if your procurement team prefers CAIQ, we can run a short mapping exercise after SIG. Procurement team, looping you in so you can let us know the preferred questionnaire target.

Looking forward — we'll follow up with the calendar invite and the Drive link for evidence collection.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Customer Security Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SolsticeAI_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx, redwood-architectural-diagram.pdf
